description:
Cut over the two callers and remove the old module.

- `OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Context` (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/context.ex): default `find_model` callback → `OctoPi.AI.ModelRegistry.find/2`.
- `OctoPi.Coder.CLI` `--model` flag: → `OctoPi.AI.ModelRegistry.resolve/1`. Update help text to show the strict `runner/model-id` form.
- Delete `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/models.ex`.
- Update `apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/context_test.exs` and any other tests that referenced the deleted module.
- Add `priv/models.example.json` to the umbrella with one anthropic and one lmstudio entry.
- Update relevant docs / README pointers.

**Tests:**
- Coder integration tests still pass.
- CLI `--model anthropic/claude-opus-4-7` resolves correctly.
- CLI `--model claude-opus-4-7` (bare id) errors with the canonical-form hint.
title: Migration: wire callers, delete OctoPi.Coder.Models
